title: Aspiring screenwriter here. Whose script would you rather read, mine or my rival’s?

commenti.body:
First of all, I love the anime setup of this whole situation. But please don't have rivals.

The truth? Both premises sound like they could be interesting. SWE could be compelling and taps into a lot of current discourse. GOW has the potential to be mindbending and emotionally powerful. So I would take a glance at both and read whichever is formatted better. And so would industry professionals, probably.
